sqlMap.select: SELECT REPORT_TABLE.*, SY1.CONTENT TABLE_NAME, SY2.CONTENT VIEW_NAME FROM REPORT_TABLE, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY1, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY2 WHERE MENU_NO = #MENU_NO:VARCHAR# AND CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR# AND REPORT_TABLE.MENU_NO = SY1.NO(+) AND SY1.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND REPORT_TABLE.RT_NO = SY2.NO(+) AND SY2.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# ORDER BY SY2.CONTENT

SELECT REPORT_ITEM.*,SY1.CONTENT REF_ITEM_NAME FROM REPORT_ITEM, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY1 WHERE RT_NO = #RT_NO:NUMERIC# AND REPORT_ITEM.REF_ITEM_NO = SY1.NO(+) AND SY1.LANGUAGE(+) = #LANGUAGE:VARCHAR# AND REPORT_ITEM.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR# ORDER BY REPORT_ITEM.ORDERNO
